title: ESM-2 Input Parameters
description: Normalized request shape for the ESM-2 embedding/scoring adapter. ESM-2 is not a design tool — it consumes sequences and emits either per-sequence pseudo-log-likelihood (pLL) scores (mode=score) or per-residue embeddings (mode=embed).

sequences.description: List of sequences to score or embed. Each item carries a stable `id` and a canonical amino-acid `sequence`.

id.description: Stable identifier. Becomes the FASTA header and the output record key.

seeds.description: Seeds threaded through for reproducibility bookkeeping. ESM-2 inference is deterministic given the weights, but Paper Crane records a seed per record so downstream filtering keys line up with design-tool outputs.

mode.description: score = pseudo-log-likelihood per sequence; embed = per-residue hidden states from --layer.

pool.description: Embedding pooling strategy (embed mode only). 'mean' averages over sequence length, 'cls' uses the BOS token, 'none' returns the full [L, D] tensor.

layer.description: Transformer layer index to extract embeddings from (embed mode only). Default 33 is the final layer of esm2_t33_650M_UR50D.
